info.title: sFlow_collector
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

properties.description:
Reference Resource: [sFlow_collector](#/sFlow_collector)
sFlow collectors that should receive the samples.

ip_address.description:
Reference Resource: [sFlow_collector](#/sFlow_collector)
IP address of the sFlow collector.If not configured,sFlow will not be programmed and sFlow datagrams will not be transmitted.

status.description: The current connectivity status of the sFlow collector. Value can either be - "ok" which means the device was  able to send sFlow datagrams to the collector and  "not-reachable"which means that sending sFlow datagrams  to the collector failed. This can be because of various  reasons such as no route to collector, interface connected  to collector is shut, etc.

udp_port.description:
Reference Resource: [sFlow_collector](#/sFlow_collector)
Specifies the UDP port used for exchanging messages between switch and sflow collector.

vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [sFlow_collector](#/sFlow_collector)
Specifies which VRF this sFlow collector should connect with. If not specified, 'default' VRF is considered.

parameters.name: sFlow.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [sFlow](#/sFlow)
sFlow identifier for the configuration. Should be alphanumeric.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
